changes.title: ingress-nginx controller-v1.12.0 is end-of-life since 2026-03
changes.detail: ingress-nginx is retired: best-effort maintenance ended in March 2026 and there will be no further releases, bug fixes or security fixes. Existing deployments keep working and the published images and charts stay available, but vulnerabilities found from now on will not be patched upstream. No further releases, bug fixes or security fixes are to be expected for the affected releases: plan the migration instead of relying on upstream fixes.
